type PracticeTask struct {
	ID                string              `json:"id"`
	Slug              string              `json:"slug"`
	Title             string              `json:"title"`
	Theme             string              `json:"theme"`
	PositionCode      string              `json:"position_code"`
	LanguageCode      string              `json:"language_code"`
	Status            int16               `json:"status"`
	Visibility        int16               `json:"visibility"`
	SourceType        int16               `json:"source_type"`
	BlueprintJSON     json.RawMessage     `json:"blueprint_json"`
	DecompositionJSON json.RawMessage     `json:"decomposition_json"`
	MetaJSON          json.RawMessage     `json:"meta_json"`
	CreatedAt         time.Time           `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt         time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
	Stacks            []PracticeTaskStack `json:"stacks,omitempty"`
	Translations      []PracticeTaskI18n  `json:"translations,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeTaskI18n struct {
	PracticeTaskID    string          `json:"practice_task_id"`
	LanguageCode      string          `json:"language_code"`
	Title             string          `json:"title"`
	Theme             string          `json:"theme"`
	BlueprintJSON     json.RawMessage `json:"blueprint_json"`
	DecompositionJSON json.RawMessage `json:"decomposition_json"`
}

type PracticeTaskStack struct {
	ID                string          `json:"id"`
	PracticeTaskID    string          `json:"practice_task_id"`
	StackCode         string          `json:"stack_code"`
	SortOrder         int             `json:"sort_order"`
	Description       *string         `json:"description,omitempty"`
	RequiredScopeJSON json.RawMessage `json:"required_scope_json"`
}

type PracticeTaskPartType struct {
	ID          string  `json:"id"`
	Code        string  `json:"code"`
	Name        string  `json:"name"`
	Category    string  `json:"category"`

	IsActive    bool    `json:"is_active"`
}

type PracticeTaskPart struct {
	ID            string                 `json:"id"`
	PartTypeCode  string                 `json:"part_type_code"`
	LanguageCode  string                 `json:"language_code"`

	Description   *string                `json:"description,omitempty"`
	ConfigJSON    json.RawMessage        `json:"config_json"`
	IsStrictOrder bool                   `json:"is_strict_order"`
	IsActive      bool                   `json:"is_active"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time              `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     time.Time              `json:"updated_at"`

}

}

}

	IsRequired             bool                         `json:"is_required"`
	IsActive               bool                         `json:"is_active"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time                    `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time                    `json:"updated_at"`

}

}

	ID                      string `json:"id"`

}

	ID                      string                             `json:"id"`

	PartSortOrder           int                                `json:"part_sort_order"`

}

	ID          string  `json:"id"`
	Code        string  `json:"code"`

}

	ID                string `json:"id"`
	MilestoneKindCode string `json:"milestone_kind_code"`

}

type LessonSkillTag struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	LessonID     string `json:"lesson_id"`
	SkillTagID   string `json:"skill_tag_id"`

}

	ID           string `json:"id"`
	TaskID       string `json:"task_id"`
	SkillTagID   string `json:"skill_tag_id"`
	SkillTagCode string `json:"skill_tag_code"`
	StackCode    string `json:"stack_code"`
}

// StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding snapshots which milestone was materialized into
// which student answer. StudentPracticeTask owns the stable workspace ids; bindings
// preserve per-answer history for result lookup, resume and milestone finalization.
type StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding struct {
	ID                             string          `json:"id"`
	StudentPracticeTaskID          string          `json:"student_practice_task_id"`
	StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID string          `json:"student_practice_task_milestone_id"`
	TaskAnswerID                   string          `json:"task_answer_id"`
	TaskID                         string          `json:"task_id"`
	LessonID                       string          `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskSnapshotJSON               json.RawMessage `json:"task_snapshot_json"`
	CreatedAt                      time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt                      time.Time       `json:"updated_at"`
}

type Roadmap struct {
	PracticeTaskID        string             `json:"practice_task_id"`
	StudentPracticeTaskID *string            `json:"student_practice_task_id,omitempty"`
	CurrentMilestoneID    *string            `json:"current_milestone_id,omitempty"`
	Stacks                []RoadmapStack     `json:"stacks"`
	Milestones            []RoadmapMilestone `json:"milestones"`
}

type RoadmapStack struct {
	StackCode               string   `json:"stack_code"`
	RequiredSkillTags       []string `json:"required_skill_tags"`
	RequiredLessonsCount    int      `json:"required_lessons_count"`
	CompletedLessonsCount   int      `json:"completed_lessons_count"`
	RemainingLessonsCount   int      `json:"remaining_lessons_count"`
	RequiredTasksCount      int      `json:"required_tasks_count"`
	RecommendedLessonsCount int      `json:"recommended_lessons_count"`
	OptionalLessonsCount    int      `json:"optional_lessons_count"`
}

type RoadmapMilestone struct {
	ID                             string          `json:"id"`
	PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID string          `json:"practice_task_runtime_milestone_id"`
	PracticeTaskMilestoneID        string          `json:"practice_task_milestone_id"`
	PracticeTaskPartID             string          `json:"practice_task_part_id"`
	MilestoneKindCode              string          `json:"milestone_kind_code"`
	StackCode                      string          `json:"stack_code"`
	StackCodes                     []string        `json:"stack_codes"`
	Title                          string          `json:"title"`
	Status                         string          `json:"status"`
	RequiredSkillTags              []string        `json:"required_skill_tags"`
	LessonIDs                      []string        `json:"lesson_ids"`
	Lessons                        []RoadmapLesson `json:"lessons"`
	TaskIDs                        []string        `json:"task_ids"`
}

type RoadmapLesson struct {
	CourseID          string  `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID          string  `json:"lesson_id"`

	SortOrder         int     `json:"sort_order"`
	PrerequisiteGroup *string `json:"prerequisite_group,omitempty"`
	AlternativeGroup  *string `json:"alternative_group,omitempty"`
	StepTitle         string  `json:"step_title,omitempty"`
	StepInstructions  string  `json:"step_instructions,omitempty"`
	Completed         bool    `json:"completed"`
}

}

type PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding struct {
	CourseID          string  `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID          string  `json:"lesson_id"`
	Requirement       string  `json:"requirement"`
	SortOrder         int     `json:"sort_order"`
	PrerequisiteGroup *string `json:"prerequisite_group,omitempty"`
	AlternativeGroup  *string `json:"alternative_group,omitempty"`
	StepTitle         string  `json:"step_title"`
	StepInstructions  string  `json:"step_instructions"`
}

type CourseCompletionClient interface {
	GetCompletedLessonIDs(ctx context.Context, userID string, lessonIDs []string) (map[string]struct{}, error)
}

func RoadmapStatusLabel(status int16) string {
	switch status {
	case StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress:
		return MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress
	case StudentMilestoneStatusPassed:
		return MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed
	case StudentMilestoneStatusFailed:
		return MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed
	case StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped:
		return MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped
	default:
		return "not_started"
	}
}

func ParsePracticeTaskStatus(value string) int16 {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
	case "active":
		return PracticeTaskStatusActive
	case "archived":
		return PracticeTaskStatusArchived
	default:
		return PracticeTaskStatusDraft
	}
}

func ParsePracticeTaskVisibility(value string) int16 {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
	case "public":
		return PracticeTaskVisibilityPublic
	default:
		return PracticeTaskVisibilityPrivate
	}
}

func ParsePracticeTaskSourceType(value string) int16 {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
	case "ai_generated":
		return PracticeTaskSourceAIGenerated
	case "hybrid":
		return PracticeTaskSourceHybrid
	default:
		return PracticeTaskSourceManual
	}
}
